key_insight: CIDERS formulates cloud-edge LLM collaboration as a personalized bilevel optimization problem, using consensus-variate correction to balance global knowledge transfer with edge-specific adaptation.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical optimization framework for deploying LLMs across cloud and edge systems where shared model quality and domain personalization must coexist.
method: Decompose the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger.
Use a bilevel objective: cloud-side lower-level knowledge transfer and edge-side upper-level personalization.
Inject global trajectory information into each local update via consensus-variate correction.
evidence_signal: Experiments show CIDERS outperforms baselines on compressed edge tasks, with 3.1x gains in mathematical reasoning, 1.7x in code generation, and about 10% relative improvement on instruction metrics.
watch_item: The approach adds optimization and coordination complexity, so stability and communication overhead may be important concerns in real cloud-edge deployments.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
